hero.title: For companies with many shareholders and corporate groups
hero.description: Sttok keeps the corporate records of every company in the group: the shareholder register with its encumbrances and co-owners, the general meeting and the board, officers with their terms and who controls each company at the end of the chain. Each person sees only the companies they are responsible for.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions from companies and groups

items.q: Does it work for a family business with several branches?
items.a: Yes. The dashboard groups shareholders by family branch, and the register records each generation's inheritances, co-ownership and usufruct.

items.q: Can I manage every company in the group?
items.a: Yes. Each company has its own register, governing bodies and permissions, and one group company can be a shareholder of another. The home screen brings together what is pending in all of them.

items.q: Does it work with hundreds or thousands of shareholders?
items.a: Yes. Sttok manages more than 250,000 shareholders and partners, including companies with hundreds and thousands of shareholders.

items.q: Does each person see only their companies?
items.a: Yes. Permissions are granted per company and per section, so each person sees and manages only what they are responsible for.

items.q: How much does it cost for a group?
items.a: Groups and companies with more than 50 shareholders have a custom plan, which is the most common case. Standard plans are on the pricing page.

items.q: Does it work for companies in Latin America?
items.a: The platform adapts to each country's terminology: shareholder ledger, general shareholders' meeting, board of directors. Compliance with each country's regulations is assessed case by case.
